＜Truck and Tractor Equipment Management Committee Regulations＞
(1977.5)

### Article 1 (Purpose)
1. To efficiently promote equipment management, a comprehensive promotion plan for business operations shall be prepared and continuously promoted. For this purpose, a Joint Equipment Management Committee (hereinafter referred to as the "Committee") shall be established in Gasi-ri.

### Article 2 (Functions)
The Committee shall deliberate and decide on the following matters:
1. Establishment and operation of income-generating business plans
2. Evaluation and analysis of business promotion performance
3. Identification of issues and organic measures for business promotion

### Article 3 (Composition)
1. The Committee shall consist of 1 chairperson and 6 members, with 1 secretary.
2. The chairperson shall be the village chief (里長), the members shall be the Saemaul leaders of Gasi-ri, and the secretary shall be the vice-myeon chief (副面長).

### Article 4 (Duties of the Chairperson, etc.)
1. The chairperson shall oversee the affairs of the Committee.
2. In the absence of the chairperson, a senior appointed leader shall perform the duties.
3. A dedicated committee member shall be appointed for each business and manage it.
    1) Truck
    2) Tractor
4. The dedicated committee members shall operate under the responsibility of the chairperson in accordance with the joint management regulations.
5. The secretary shall prepare and keep minutes of the meeting, which shall include the following items:
    1) Date and place of the opening and closing of the meeting
    2) List of attending committee members
    3) Items deliberated and resolved
    4) Other necessary matters

### Article 5 (Meetings)
1. The chairperson shall convene the Committee and act as the presiding officer.
2. Meetings shall be regular and extraordinary. Regular meetings shall be held once a month, and extraordinary meetings shall be convened as necessary by the chairperson.

### Article 6 (Votes)
1. A meeting shall be opened with the attendance of more than half of the committee members including the chairperson, and a resolution shall be passed with the approval of more than half of the attending committee members.

### Article 7 (Allowances and Travel Expenses)
1. Travel expenses and allowances may be paid to the chairperson and committee members in accordance with separate regulations.

### Article 8 (Other Necessary Matters)
1. Matters concerning the operation of the management committee other than those provided for in these regulations shall be decided by the chairperson after deliberation by the meeting.


--- (p. 983) ---

### Chapter 4
1. This regulation shall be enforced from OOO.

### 4. Future Development Plan (發展構想)

*   By 1981, 1,000 hectares of grassland will be fully improved (完全 完全) to raise 4 cattle per hectare (當), aiming to breed 4,000 cattle annually (年間增殖).
*   Utilize fallow farmland (農土) and labor (勞動力) to the maximum (最大限) through mushroom cultivation (栽培), and increase income (所得增大) by processing mushroom spawn for export (輸出).
*   Expand the women's association's (婦女會) purchasing and selling business (購販事業) to supply daily necessities (生必品) at lower prices (價格).


--- (p. 984) ---

# Editor's Note

We have gathered here the records of Saemaul, which were achieved by overcoming hardships and adversities, by digging, breaking through, expanding, and building up.

We have endeavored to compile these records, centering around village meeting minutes, in a distinctive manner. However, since we had to condense vast amounts of material within a short period, many regrets remain. The meeting minutes are presented without modifying the local dialects, regional languages, and colloquial expressions.

Although they are not refined pieces of writing, their rustic simplicity, redolent with the scent of earth, is precisely what makes them valuable.

We hope to supplement the shortcomings in this volume with the forthcoming second volume, and we aspire to publish a more substantial book. We hope that this single volume will contribute, even slightly, to the development of the Saemaul Undong.

We express our gratitude to the village residents who provided the materials, the frontline Saemaul department officials who collected and organized them, and the employees of Seoul Printing Company who completed the printing in a short time despite working overnight.
